purpose: Organizational layer for T6 relic-efficiency analysis. Tasks are grouped before any compatibility percentages are assigned.
principles: Task-centered analysis: relics are compared against task groups and representative singular tasks, not tasks assigned to a single relic.
Two orthogonal labels: domain/system and completion shape.
Group compatibility is qualitative only at this stage: primary, supporting, edge-only, usually-neutral.
Composite/RNG/equipment/meta tasks must be decomposed before numeric scoring.
Existing relics Golden Touch, Divine Druid, Voidwalker, Transmutation and Devout are the baseline; candidate value is incremental.

shape_definitions.atomic: One main completion event or short fixed chain.
shape_definitions.threshold: Level, XP, currency, reputation or score threshold.
shape_definitions.composite: Bundle of distinct requirements; must decompose.
shape_definitions.access: Quest, unlock, travel or access gate.

compatibility_roles.primary: Relic usually attacks the dominant bottleneck for this subgroup.
compatibility_roles.supporting: Relic meaningfully reduces part of the burden but is not normally the dominant transformation.
compatibility_roles.edge_only: Can matter for some individual tasks/routes; do not assign subgroup-wide percentage without inspection.
compatibility_roles.usually_neutral: No general direct value for this subgroup under the user's existing League baseline.
